title: Mace Limit's
description: Mace Limit is a datapack that restricts the mace to only 3 per world
body:
Mace Limit is a datapack that restricts the mace to only 3 unique, handcrafted weapons in the entire world. No two players can own the same mace — once a mace is forged, it is gone forever.

 Each mace requires a different crafting recipe and carries its own enchantments, name, and lore. When a mace is forged, the entire server is notified with a title broadcast. The counter persists through restarts.
 
###  The 3 maces


###  The Mace

- Breach IV · Density V · Wind Burst II · Unbreakable
  
- Recipe: Heavy Core + Breeze Rod + Netherite Ingot
  
###  Titans Fist

- Density V · Wind Burst II · Unbreakable
  
- Recipe: Heavy Core + Breeze Rod + Diamond
  
###  Galebreaker
 
- Breach III · Wind Burst II · Unbreakable
  
- Recipe: Heavy Core + Breeze Rod + Emerald

###  Admin commands 

```
 /function mace_limit:admin_check
 /function mace_limit:admin_reset
 /execute as <player> run function mace_limit:admin_give_mace1
 /execute as <player> run function mace_limit:admin_give_mace2
 /execute as <player> run function mace_limit:admin_give_mace3
```


### Important note

**Do not craft a mace while already carrying one in your inventory. The existing mace will be replaced and may become glitched. A server-wide reminder is broadcast every 30 minutes.**
